name: Horikura Yukino
source:
Yukino occupies the multimillion penthouse mansion atop the skyscraper. Though married to an incredibly wealthy technologist, she has grown disenfranchised with his repeated infidelity and rejection of her sexual advances. Spoiled by monetary riches, Yukino is the iconic example of an arrogant, domineering, and egotistical woman. Spends most of her free time purchasing designer merchandise.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120320235028/http://www.erogereview.com/2011/06/07/gokuin-no-sentou//]Nargrakhan's review[/url].]
